com.viaoa.object

Class OAObjectGrid

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.viaoa.object.OAObjectGrid

  • public class OAObjectGrid
extends Object
    Create a two dimensional (cols & rows) of data. Each column is given a property path to a link property, which can be type one or many.
    Columns can be populated with:
    • Hub
    • single OAObject
    • property path from another column (master/detail)
    • Hub of Objects that can be grouped by another column.
    The rows are then created to form a data grid (/table).
    Author:
    vvia
